stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical Cisco SD-WAN 0-Day Flaw to Deploy KeyDrift Malware and Steal Encryption Keys
stories.description: Hackers exploited Cisco SD-WAN zero-day CVE-2026-20127 to deploy KeyDrift malware, steal encryption keys, and gain admin access.

stories.title: BAE Says No Data Extracted in Incident Hitting Bankruptcy Courts
stories.description: BAE Systems says no data was extracted and no PII was breached in the incident that disrupted US bankruptcy court notices for weeks.

stories.title: Over 41,000 DHS Employee Records Leaked Online
stories.description: The personal and work information was allegedly stolen from an Okta single sign-on system earlier this year.

stories.title: Chinese Hackers Use Secret Silent Train Network to Exploit Zero-Days Against U.S. Government and Defense
stories.description: China-linked Volt Typhoon uses the Silent Train network to conceal attacks on U.S. agencies, defense firms, and critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Hackers Claim Wagyu Crypto Platform Breach as Researchers Find Thousands of Monero Transaction Records
stories.description: Wagyu faces a claimed data breach exposing 38,628 swap records and 10,139 IP addresses linking Monero transactions to blockchain payments.

stories.title: Webinar: How to Build AI Threat Readiness Into Your Security Operations
stories.description: Wiz webinar shows how security teams can use unified context to prioritize exposure and respond faster to AI-assisted attacks.

stories.title: Telegram Android Flaw Lets Attackers Run Code When Users Answer Voice Calls
stories.description: NebuSec demonstrated code execution through an answered Telegram for Android voice call; the flaw was fixed in version 12.10.4.

stories.title: The Rise of the Threat Operator: How AI Will Redefine Security Operations and Careers
stories.description: AI-driven SOCs are reshaping analyst roles, with Threat Operators overseeing automated investigations, response decisions, and business risk.

stories.title: 26,400 Valid Cloud and AI Credentials Found Exposed in Public Gitee Repositories
stories.description: A scan of 7.25 million public Gitee repositories found 26,400 working credentials, including Alibaba Cloud, DeepSeek and OpenAI keys.

stories.title: Hackers Attack FreePBX Servers With Malware to Steal SIP Credentials for Phone Fraud
stories.description: INJ3CTOR3 malware targets FreePBX servers, stealing SIP passwords, database credentials, and secrets to sustain phone fraud after rebuilds.

stories.title: Hackers Steal 2.6 Million Records From Sony’s Japanese ISP So-net
stories.description: The data of So-net and Plala customers in Japan was exposed, along with 54,401 email account passwords and 16 bank account records.

stories.title: Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Exploitation Tied to Volt Typhoon’s ‘Silent Train’ Network
stories.description: Cisco Talos linked SD-WAN key-stealing malware to infrastructure overlapping Volt Typhoon’s Silent Train network, which Lumen detailed.
